f3_program: collection("monica.cookies", "cookie", "monica", source("Monica made cookies for herself and her family"))
observe(at("monica.cookies.count", "initial"), 30, "count", source("she made 30 cookies in total"))
consume("father_eats", "monica.father", at("monica.cookies.count", "current"), 10, source("Her father ate 10 cookies"))
consume("mother_eats", "monica.mother", at("monica.cookies.count", "current"), fraction(event_field("father_eats", "quantity"), 1, 2), source("her mother ate half as much as the father"))
offset(at("monica.brother.cookies_eaten.count", "current"), event_field("mother_eats", "quantity"), 2, "count", source("Her brother ate 2 more than her mother"))
consume("brother_eats", "monica.brother", at("monica.cookies.count", "current"), at("monica.brother.cookies_eaten.count", "current"), source("Her brother ate 2 more than her mother"))
query("remaining_count", "monica.cookies", "current")
assumptions: The 30 cookies made in total are the initial cookie pool before the three family members eat from it.

f3_program: collection("jenna.friends", "friend", "jenna", source("her group of five friends"))
observe(at("jenna.friends.count", "current"), 5, "count", source("five friends"))
collection("jenna.friends.concert_tickets", "ticket", "jenna.friends", source("concert tickets for her group of five friends"))
collection("jenna.friends.ticket_payments", "payment", "jenna.friends", source("buying concert tickets for her group of five friends"))
observe(at("jenna.friends.concert_tickets.website.count", "current"), 2, "count", source("two of the tickets from the concert website"))
observe(at("concert.ticket.website.unit_price", "current"), 50, "dollar", source("$50 each"))

same(at("concert.ticket.normal_price", "current"), at("concert.ticket.website.unit_price", "current"), source("$50 each before they sell out. A scalper offers to sell her two more tickets for 240% of the normal price"))

product_relation(at("jenna.friends.ticket_payments.website", "current"), at("jenna.friends.concert_tickets.website.count", "current"), at("concert.ticket.website.unit_price", "current"), source("two of the tickets from the concert website for $50 each"))
member("jenna.friends.ticket_payments", "jenna.friends.ticket_payments.website", source("two of the tickets from the concert website for $50 each"))
observe(at("jenna.friends.concert_tickets.scalper.count", "current"), 2, "count", source("two more tickets"))
percent_of(at("jenna.friends.concert_tickets.scalper.unit_price", "current"), at("concert.ticket.normal_price", "current"), 240, source("240% of the normal price"))

product_relation(at("jenna.friends.ticket_payments.scalper.before_discount", "current"), at("jenna.friends.concert_tickets.scalper.count", "current"), at("jenna.friends.concert_tickets.scalper.unit_price", "current"), source("two more tickets for 240% of the normal price"))
offset(at("jenna.friends.ticket_payments.scalper", "current"), at("jenna.friends.ticket_payments.scalper.before_discount", "current"), -10, "dollar", source("$10 off that total payment"))

member("jenna.friends.ticket_payments", "jenna.friends.ticket_payments.scalper", source("A scalper offers to sell her two more tickets for 240% of the normal price, but Jenna convinces him to give her $10 off that total payment"))
observe(at("jenna.friends.concert_tickets.job_discount.count", "current"), 1, "count", source("one of her friends gets a discounted ticket"))
percent_of(at("jenna.friends.concert_tickets.job_discount.unit_price", "current"), at("concert.ticket.normal_price", "current"), 60, source("60% of the normal price"))

product_relation(at("jenna.friends.ticket_payments.job_discount", "current"), at("jenna.friends.concert_tickets.job_discount.count", "current"), at("jenna.friends.concert_tickets.job_discount.unit_price", "current"), source("one of her friends gets a discounted ticket through her job for 60% of the normal price"))
member("jenna.friends.ticket_payments", "jenna.friends.ticket_payments.job_discount", source("one of her friends gets a discounted ticket through her job for 60% of the normal price"))
query("sum", "jenna.friends.ticket_payments", "current")
assumptions: The later phrase "the normal price" refers to the $50 website ticket price.
